notes: Window = union of a 250 m disc at the origin and a 120 m disc around every graph node whose kind is in exit_kinds (exit connector) or whose floorId is in street_floor_ids (street-level node); exit_poi_connectors adds the graph nodes that stations/ikebukuro/gteki/pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of POIs with category exit (x36f, x4f, x13f: exits whose connector is a b1 stair foot, not a street node). graph.json and pois.json are read-only and their sha256 go in the receipt. The window touches third-level meshes 53394576 and 53394577 only (plus 50 m mesh_margin_m for features that straddle a mesh edge; a third mesh, 53394586, first matters at roughly 100-110 m, with or without the stair-foot discs); a missing or unacquired mesh fails the run. Default merge kind = one building mesh and one road mesh. Visual-only context (gteki_role context, NOT_FOR_ROUTING); textures are not converted. Default kinds = ["bldg"]: roads (tran) are on rights HOLD (merge lead, #39, 2026-10-22) because the PLATEAU tran lineage cites GSI approval 令7関公第296号 with unconfirmed scope; a road build needs an explicit --kinds tran or bldg,tran and must not ship until that HOLD is lifted.
